input.question: Which Kafka topics does the transfer service publish to?
schema: Relationship type PUBLISHES_TO (category technical): The method sends messages to the Kafka topic. From JavaMethod to KafkaTopic. Properties: . Query hints: {direction=out, weight=0.7}.
Relationship type CONSUMES_FROM (category technical): The method listens to the Kafka topic. From JavaMethod to KafkaTopic. Properties: . Query hints: {direction=out, weight=0.7}.

Entity type KafkaTopic (label :KafkaTopic, category technical): A Kafka topic, by name as written in code (placeholders kept as written). Properties: name, placeholder. Outgoing: RELATED_TO->*, TESTED_BY->TestCase. Incoming: JavaMethod-CONSUMES_FROM->, JavaMethod-PUBLISHES_TO->.
Relationship type DECLARES (category technical): The type declares the method or constructor. From JavaClass to JavaMethod. Properties: . Query hints: {direction=out, weight=0.4}.

Relationship type CALLS (category technical): The source method invokes the target method (static call resolution). From JavaMethod to JavaMethod. Properties: callCount, resolution. Query hints: {direction=out, weight=0.6}.
Relationship type WRITES_TO (category technical): The method writes the table (through a JPA repository). From JavaMethod to DatabaseTable. Properties: . Query hints: {direction=out, weight=0.7}.

Relationship type LOGS (category technical): The method emits the log statement; order is its position in the method. From JavaMethod to LogStatement. Properties: order. Query hints: {direction=out, weight=0.3}.

Entity type JavaMethod (label :JavaMethod, category technical): A method or constructor, identified by repository, declaring type and erased signature. Properties: repository, fqcn, signature, summary, lineStart, lineEnd, returnType, annotations, bodyHash, unresolvedCalls, test. Outgoing: CALLS->JavaMethod, CONSUMES_FROM->KafkaTopic, IMPLEMENTS_REQUIREMENT->BusinessRequirement, LOGS->LogStatement, PUBLISHES_TO->KafkaTopic, READS_FROM->DatabaseTable, RELATED_TO->*, TESTED_BY->TestCase, THROWS_ERROR->ErrorCode, USES_CONFIGURATION->ConfigProperty, WRITES_TO->DatabaseTable. Incoming: JavaMethod-CALLS->, JavaClass-DECLARES->, ApiOperation-HANDLED_BY->, KnowledgeCard|BusinessRequirement-IMPLEMENTED_BY->.

response.cypher: MATCH (m:JavaMethod)-[:PUBLISHES_TO]->(t:KafkaTopic) WHERE m.pke_id IN $seedIds RETURN DISTINCT t.pke_id AS id, 'KafkaTopic' AS type, t.name AS label, m.signature AS detail LIMIT 50
response.explanation: Kafka topics that the seed methods publish to, with the publishing method.
